## Workload

Elif Sahin completed grading activity during 264 rostered hours. The workload comprised 571 sets, equivalent to 2.2 reads per hour. This output was recorded for the quarter and reflects the volume of work allocated during the review period. The workload was managed within the available rostered time.

## Quality

A sample of 43 sets was read again as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement rate was 48.8 per cent. The review identified borderline background cases, and feedback was provided to support consistent decisions in these cases. The findings should be considered alongside the workload information and the nature of the material reviewed.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
